Rule 3 (taxi): taxi items are reimbursed by default. Exception: if the trip is international, it is rejected instead. However, in that case, if the claimant is a contractor, it is reimbursed. Rule 3 (reference books): reference books items are approved by default. Exception: if it is requested outside the exam period, it is refused instead. However, in that case, if the item is older than 161 years, it is approved. However, in that case, if unpaid fines are at most $30, it is refused. However, in that case, if the request is signed by the department chair, it is approved. But if, in addition, the borrower has no overdue items, it is refused after all.

request.state:
COMPANY EXPENSE REIMBURSEMENT POLICY
Each expense is decided by the rule for its category. Within a rule, every exception clause is only considered if the clause immediately before it applied; when an exception applies, its decision replaces the previous one.

Rule 1 (software): software items are rejected by default. Exception: if it was not paid with the corporate card, it is reimbursed instead. Even then, if it was pre-approved by a Manager, it is rejected. However, in that case, if it was submitted within 71 days of purchase, it is reimbursed.
Rule 2 (training courses): training courses items are reimbursed by default. Exception: if a receipt is attached, it is rejected instead. However, in that case, if it was submitted more than 16 days after purchase, it is reimbursed. But if, in addition, it was incurred on a weekend, it is rejected after all.
Rule 3 (meals): meals items are reimbursed by default. Exception: if the claimant is a contractor, it is rejected instead. Further exception to the previous clause: if it was not paid with the corporate card, it is reimbursed. Even then, if no receipt is attached, it is rejected.

- Expense 2 (category: meals) - claimant type: a contractor; receipt attached: yes; paid with corporate card: no; incurred on a weekend: yes.

A1.instructions: Under the policy, Expense 2 (meals) is reimbursed.

criteria.only_first: Expense 1 (training courses) is reimbursed, Expense 2 (meals) is rejected

Rule 1 (archive vault): archive vault items are denied by default. Exception: if the badge clearance is at most level 8, it is granted instead. Each claim is decided by the rule for its category. Within a rule, every exception clause is only considered if the clause immediately before it applied; when an exception applies, its decision replaces the previous one.

Rule 1 (windstorm): windstorm items are covered by default. Exception: if no monitored alarm was installed, it is denied instead. However, in that case, if there are at most 4 prior claims in the last 3 years, it is covered. But if, in addition, a police report was filed, it is denied after all. Even then, if the incident was reported within 43 days of it happening, it is covered.
Rule 2 (theft): theft items are covered by default. Exception: if the property is not in a coastal region, it is denied instead. Even then, if the home was vacant at the time, it is covered. Even then, if the home is at most 26 years old, it is denied. However, in that case, if the damage was assessed by a licensed adjuster, it is covered.

- Claim 2 (category: windstorm) - prior claims in last 3 years: 5; police report filed: no; home vacant at time of incident: no; days before incident was reported: 43 days; monitored alarm installed: no; policy tier: premium.

A0.instructions: Under the policy, Claim 1 (theft) is covered.
